manual_read.semantics: Final name/MC/OA/foreign refer only to affirmative own final identity. Definite other-model selfclaim, thirdparty attribution rewrites, nonanswers, task explanation and response-planning leakage are separate. Generic safety-policy references and hypothetical third-party systems do not become invented-own-system counts. No full factual audit, raw rewrite, promotion or release claim.
